title: Correct initial velocity
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be v₀ = 4 m/s.

title: Correct plane acceleration
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be a ≈ 13.3 m/s².

title: Projectile time calculation
description: Important: Must correctly calculate the flight time t from the vertical drop h = ½gt².

title: Geometry relationship application
description: Important: Must use tanθ = h/x for part (1) to relate vertical and horizontal displacements.

title: Relative motion setup
description: Important: For part (2), must recognize that the ball lands on the moving plane when the vertical displacement h₂ and the relative horizontal displacement (x₂ - x₁) satisfy tanθ = h₂/(x₂ - x₁).

title: Kinematic equations for plane
description: Important: Must correctly write the horizontal displacement of the plane as x₁ = ½at₂².

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All quantities should maintain consistent units (m, s, m/s, m/s²).

title: Sign error in relative displacement
description: Pitfall: Using x₂ + x₁ instead of x₂ - x₁ for the relative horizontal displacement in part (2).

title: Incorrect time substitution
description: Pitfall: Using the full flight time t from part (1) instead of the given t₂ = 0.3 s in part (2).
